title: Sun is 400 times larger and 400 times farther away than the moon

tellings.quote: The sun is 400 times larger than the moon and 400 times farther away.

plain: The sun is 400 times larger than the moon and also 400 times farther away, so the two look about the same size in our sky. The researcher Randall Carlson points this out without naming a source, in a conversation that asks whether the moon could be something other than natural.
